cleavage agent: strict specificity for trypsin cleavage was required
enrichment method: Total lysis of the P. berghei pG230 strain trophozoites was followed by anti-HA immunoprecipitation to generate wild-type samples.
labeling: Proteins were quantified according to the MaxQuant label-free quantitation (LFQ) algorithm.
reduction reagent: total lysis buffer (50 mM Tris pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, 1% Triton X-100, 0.5 mM EDTA, 0.2 U/mL DNase, Roche cOmplete EDTA-free anti-protease cocktail)
